item.text: Are there any comments or concerns about the (correct) home storage of the medication?

valueCoding.display: Safe storage and management of medication

item.text: Are there any contraindications for administration?
Heart rate above 100 bpm at rest or irregular heart rhythm, unless a chronically known problem.
A weight gain of 3 kg / 3 weeks or 5 kg / 6 weeks, especially in combination with increased edema.
Increased edema of the hands and/or feet.
Increased breathlessness and/or severe breathlessness (i.e. breathlessness at rest/without exertion and/or breathlessness that interferes with daily activities) (Trastuzumab, Azacitidine)

Thank you.
